nav-appeals.title: Start with appeals
nav-appeals.text: Your questions, ideas and suggestions live here. Click Appeals in the sidebar to learn how to create one.

create.title: Share your question
create.text: Click Create appeal to open a form for a problem, an idea or a thank-you to your colleagues.

form.title: Focus on the essentials
form.text: Choose a category, add a short title and describe the situation. You can also suggest a solution and attach files.

anonymous.title: Choose how to send it
anonymous.text: Enable Send anonymously to hide your name from participants. This switch is always next to the create button.

submit.title: You’re ready!
submit.text: This button sends a completed appeal. During the tour, clicking it only finishes the guide. After the tour, complete the form and submit when ready.

avatarHint: PNG or JPEG, up to 5 MB
telegramConnected: Notifications are connected. You can also send /stop to the bot.
telegramHint: Receive new messages and appeal updates in a private chat with the bot.
telegramStart: Press Start in Telegram. This link expires in 10 minutes and can only be used once.
telegramDisabled: The administrator needs to configure TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN on the server.
